entries.title: A demo can be a short GIF when a video cannot be made
entries.body: When a crewmate cannot make a video of how a change works, its card can show the demo as a short GIF instead. It looks the same on the card, a still with a Play button; in the large viewer it plays once when you press Play, Stop takes it back to the still, and Replay plays it again. Nothing plays on its own or loops.

picture.alt: The large viewer playing a GIF demo of a box sliding right, with a Stop button and the time at one second of three
